authority: Existing independent contributor PR #1327 only. Amalgam #1278 owns accepted model/integration. Protected original-world first use #426 not authorized.
hypothesis: Can the source-only KNOW23 quarantined-writer independently conditioned on four public 2-bit contexts transfer FIT learned causal knowledge to unfamiliar Boolean operator families, beating a matched independently fully-fitted contextual Beta learner, while retaining original associations?

world.public: c=x0+2*x1 in 0..3, a=(step//4)%2, c=step%4; visits 4 contexts × 2 actions every 8 steps. One latent operator fixed within each world. No private operator, private best action, noise bit or oracle target shared with learners.

operators.held_xnor: best action=1 XOR x0 XOR x1

world.reward: one witnessed Bernoulli outcome: p=.80 on best action; p=.20 on the other. Independent exogenous SHA256(seed,operator,step), not action. Never infer outcome from any counterfactual before query.

candidate.scope: Numeric research-only four-public-context bank of original KNOW23 QuarantineWriteMemory (two bounded Beta slots × binary action per context); not original native GF2 learning or canonical Yggdrasil integration.
candidate.train: Train every context from same fixed 96 FIT witnessed actions; finish any pending public events; preserve exact per-context counters and old forecast.
candidate.cold: Canonical context key set {0,1,2,3}, original per-context SHA256 checkpoint plus base64 if necessary; exact restore and no duplicate/replayed local events.
candidate.new_world: Clone FIT bank, reset public episode cursor per context, keep prior learned counters, reset common posterior readout weight to .5; 24 warmup witnessed outcomes precede 40 scored future outcomes.

controls: Four-context original immediate-write TwoSlotMemory with identical KNOW23 posterior reader, fully fit
Four-context KNOW23 quarantine with NO FIT, identical 24 warmup and 40 eval updates
Independent fully fitted contextual Beta(1,1) over eight public context/action pairs, same FIT and HELD outcomes
Fully fitted contextual rolling-last-8 Beta for each public context/action pair, same evidence
Fully fitted pooled Beta ignoring public context, negative
Bayesian over five private operator families with uniform prior and correctly known .8/.2 emissions, no private operator label; EXTRA STRUCTURAL PRIOR, not equal-information architecture

metrics.primary: Prequential Brier across 12×40=480 held scored events per arm, predictions BEFORE one consequence and witness afterward
secondary: Per novel operator Brier and fitted vs no-FIT
Eight original FIT public context/action forecast drift after 64 conflicting outcomes, exact cold return
96 FIT, 288 warmup, 480 scored witness counts for each arm; pending internal commits NOT extra world actions
State bytes and elapsed Python time without CI/setup; no comparable speed gain

frozen_predicates.H1: Quarantine FIT Brier beats immediate-write contextual FIT by >=0.01000
frozen_predicates.H2: Quarantine FIT Brier <= independently fully fitted contextual Beta
frozen_predicates.H3: Quarantine FIT Brier beats identical no-FIT quarantine by >=0.01000
frozen_predicates.H4: No old FIT contextual A forecast changes after all unfamiliar operator held training
frozen_predicates.decision: All four required for DEV_TRANSFER_SUPPORTED, some for MIXED, none for OPERATOR_TRANSFER_NO_GO. Do not tune after results.

engineering: Six-job existing Linux+Windows focused/atlas/full-final/old consumed-source compatibility. Source and replay/cold negative controls, no extra first-use or private labels. Tests passing != gain.
science: Always SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO_SYNTHETIC: separate owner-qualified original-world unfamiliar law, fully trained strongest capacity/info/compute-matched controls, independent replication, cold retention, adaptive intervention value and whole-process cost required.
limits: No new controller/runner/scheduler, accepted ref, owner checkpoint, model merge/promotion, live protected original-world first use, paid API or separate PR; do not replay previous scored seeds.
